intro: Visa-free entry for 30 days and a clear procedure for obtaining a residence permit through employment or a company. The leading Russian-speaking IT community in Europe.
climate: Continental — cold snowy winters and warm summers. In winter there is smog in major cities.
mentality: Balkan hospitality and strong family values. A historically positive attitude towards Russians.
language_note: Serbian in Cyrillic is close to Russian and is learned quickly. English is widely spoken in Belgrade.
visa_note: Visa-free for 30 days, with in-country extension. A residence permit through employment, a company (PR/DOO) or marriage. Setting up a company takes 2–3 weeks.
